kjv: keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me (Jesus)
mine: keep them (the disciples) in Your name, which You have given Me (Jesus)
note: TR "hous" (those whom) against "ho" (dative "which", attracted to "name") in P66, P75, Sinaiticus, B; the early text speaks of the divine name given to Jesus. Also 17:12.

kjv: thou (the Father) shouldest keep them (the disciples) from the evil
mine: that You (the Father) keep them (the disciples) from the evil one
note: tou ponerou is most likely masculine, as in 1 Jn 2:13–14, 5:18–19.
